title: Pytest collection fails on live-server helper parameter
reasoning: Because this file is named test_flow.py and the function name starts with test_, pytest will collect test_with_live_server as a test. The base_url argument is then interpreted as a fixture, but this file does not define one. Under the declared command hatch run pytest, this can fail collection/execution before the intended isolated script path is useful.
reproduction: Run hatch run pytest; pytest will attempt to collect scripts/test_flow.py::test_with_live_server and report that fixture 'base_url' is not found unless an external conftest happens to provide it.
recommendation: Rename this helper so pytest does not collect it, for example run_with_live_server, or mark it explicitly skipped unless a fixture/CLI integration is provided.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The problematic function is itself part of the collected test suite, so collection fails before another test can assert the intended behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Run hatch run pytest and verify scripts/test_flow.py collects without missing-fixture errors.
minimumFixScope: Rename or mark only the live-server helper in scripts/test_flow.py.

history.reasoning: The original evidence still points to scripts/test_flow.py, but the live-server helper has changed: line 19 is now `def run_with_live_server(base_url: str) -> None:`, so pytest no longer treats that base_url parameter as a fixture. A repo-wide search found no remaining `def test_with_live_server` symbol. Current pytest config in pyproject.toml restricts default discovery to `testpaths = ["tests"]`, so `hatch run pytest`/default pytest should not collect scripts/test_flow.py. Explicit collection of scripts/test_flow.py now collects only `scripts/test_flow.py::test_with_testclient` and does not report a missing `base_url` fixture. Full default collection could not complete in this read-only sandbox because tests/conftest.py calls tempfile.mkdtemp and the sandbox exposes no writable temp directory; that failure is unrelated to the reported live-server fixture issue.
